name: codec
description:
Encode/decode: op=hash computes hashes, op=decode decodes base64/hex/url/html/rot13.
Hashing supports md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3_224, sha3_256, sha3_384, sha3_512, blake2b, b2sum, blake2s, blake3, crc32, adler32, or all/mainstream to compute them all; b2sum is equivalent to GNU coreutils BLAKE2b-512. To match shell echo semantics, include the trailing newline in input_text.

input_text.description: Input text bytes. Include the trailing \n when matching shell commands like echo.

input_format.description: Input encoding. For op=hash, optional: text/hex/base64 (default text); required for op=decode.

algorithms.description: op=hash only: algorithm names, comma- or space-separated; all/mainstream means compute them all. Default sha256.
